title: Precision of Marginal Sensitivity Bounds for Rare Outcomes at Saturation
banked_reason: Sound rare-Bernoulli risk and honest-length brackets remain separated by a logarithmic factor; the exact matched frontier and propensity price are undelivered, below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The promised complete matched risk/length surfaces and supplied-propensity comparison have been replaced by an unresolved U_beta--D_beta logarithmic bracket; the explicit estimator and interval are usable partial results, but they do not deliver the headline frontier.

State after this strongest proved theorem what is new, why its rare-Bernoulli plateau-uniform upper certificate matters, and precisely how it differs from the fixed-Gamma DVDS result and the Gaussian Holder L1 upper results; the global discussion does not supply the required theorem-level comparison at this node.
proof_attempt_summary: Derived total observable localized-polynomial risk and finite-n honest-length upper procedures, original-record lower brackets with disclosed propensity, and the nq consistency boundary. The exact Holder logarithms, matched risk-versus-length surfaces, and propensity price remain open; independent validity review confirms sound incremental partial mathematics below the field floor.
tldr: An established sharp marginal-sensitivity endpoint for rare binary outcomes becomes a nonsmooth intensity functional when \(\Gamma=q^{-1}\). The benchmark has known uniform covariates, a deterministic zero control arm, and bounded \(q\)-scaled H\"{o}lder intensity; it permits saturation plateaus. The headline is the matched absolute-risk and finite-sample ninety-percent honest connected-length frontier, including every logarithm and bounded-information regime, in both information experiments. Exact binomial moments and original-record likelihoods provide construction handles for the unresolved H\"{o}lder logarithm. Propensity-disclosure ratios are conditional consequences of the matched surfaces; a separate practically meaningful transition requires its own sharp proof. The scope is this benchmark rather than general MSM precision.
gap: Dorn--Guo--Kallus establishes the target but uses density-controlled threshold crossing at fixed sensitivity for binary efficiency. The direct Gaussian H\"{o}lder predecessor is Lepski--Nemirovski--Spokoiny; corrected Han--Jiao--Mukherjee leaves its supremum-class gap open. No cited donor supplies the matched rare original-record risk and finite-honest-length law.
fill: The completion criterion is four matched closed-regime precision surfaces, total observable attaining procedures, finite-sample ninety-percent honest connected intervals, and all-procedure original-record converses. Propensity-disclosure ratios follow conditionally from these surfaces; an independently highlighted phase transition requires a separately sharp and practically meaningful result. A nonmatching bracket, regular submodel or supplied-propensity-only result does not meet the criterion.
